title: The TEAM Prompts
promise: Brief ChatGPT or Claude the way you'd brief a new hire, and hand off the messages that pull you back in after hours.
points: A 60-second check that shows which after-hours task to hand off first.
Six copy-paste prompts, starting with one that turns a voice memo into steps for your team.
How to save your brief once so you stop re-explaining your business.
